notes: colourMatik 1.7.9 — a deep error check found four problems and fixed them. (1) Grades could vanish from older projects: the effect's LUT files were deleted after the newest 200, and a clip whose file is gone renders ungraded with no warning. Retention now keeps every file a saved project can still point at and only removes superseded drafts and slider steps. (2) Match All on 4K footage used up to 13 GB of RAM - frames are now matched at 1920 px (same look, measured): 3.3 GB and up to 40% faster. (3) Same-scene matches computed their accuracy report over 14.5M pixels: 14.9 s / 8.7 GB -> 5.4 s / 3.3 GB. (4) The LUT solver needed SciPy 1.12+ while the requirements allowed older - it now works on any version.
